## Welcome to your practice report

This is a **Quarto** document. It mixes ordinary writing with live code, so your
report and your analysis always stay in sync. When you render it, Quarto runs
the code below and builds a finished HTML page.

Try it now: change `author: "Your Name"` in the header above to your own name,
then render this file.

## A first look at the data

The code chunk below reads a small practice dataset, `patients.csv`, which sits
next to this file, and shows the first few rows.

```{r}
patients <- read.csv("patients.csv")
head(patients)
```

## A first chart

```{r}
hist(patients$age,
     main = "Age distribution of practice patients",
     xlab = "Age (years)",
     col  = "steelblue")
```

## A chart with ggplot2

This chart uses the ggplot2 package, so it also checks that the course packages
are installed.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(patients, aes(x = age, y = systolic_bp, colour = diabetes)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Systolic blood pressure (mm Hg)",
       colour = "Diabetes")
```
